notes.title: Quick Note on Upcoming Updates
notes.content:
[b]Hello all, [/b]

Hope you are doing well!

I wanted to give a quick shout since it has been a while.

[h3]As many of you have noticed things been moving rather slow. This partly due to funding (or lack thereof) issues for this project but also the sheer amount of work involved. Nonetheless, slowly but surely, things are moving in the right direction.  Also, to put some of you at ease, I have no intentions of abandoning this project, surrender is not an option, fight to the death![/h3]


[h2]The good[/h2]

I am happy to say, I have completed an entirely new open world system. This will allow us to have a huge map without any loading. The best part about this is that, you (the potential Modder) will be able to create an entirely new map using your own assets. You will however need to use the Unity editor to make these maps and I will make a tutorial when the time comes -it is not too difficult. 

I am nearly finished with a whole new vehicle controls system, and this will probably take of the whole of this month to complete. 

Input system has also been overhauled, including the ability to remap control bindings. But one big item remains. Which is is the overhaul of the interaction system -my previous attempts of updating the existing system has been subpar. Once this is complete, you will also be able to also play without VR, which I am personally very excited about!

I am, also laying the foundation for the campaign, it will be a survival type campaign where you ultimately must reach the enemy lines, with as much of your crew as possible. I will have more information on this later, as it is a little way away -hopefully, before the end of the year!
 
[h2]The (somewhat) bad/changes (though some might find this be good!)[/h2]

The physics interactions will be completely removed. I tried to get this to work but due to performance limitations of VR and the tight spaces in the vehicle, this creates far more issues than the fun it delivers. To be frank, it is simply not fun at times. Also, if I am not mistaken (from feedback I got) most you do prefer simple controls over complex and potentially clunky physical interactions.

This also means, you must grab/interact with a button first (no more pushing with the hand) then move. Shell loading will also have to be somewhat simplified. For VR, you can still grab and place the shell, but it will insert itself. I will work on this more though, to see if I can get it back to where it is now. No promises!

And I have a bit of a dilemma. I must migrate all of these in one go because all systems are interconnected. If I were to update one system at a time, there is a good chance that game is going to break (which is also why you haven’t seen any small updates thus far). There are too many VR devices to account for, which makes this process even more challenging. 

Because of this and all the remaining work, it is unlikely you will see a game update until sometime in August 2022, but rest assured it is coming.

Lastly, I apologize for the long radio silence -it’s been bit rough going, but it is going! and I will do my best to keep you informed going forward.


Cheers!

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello all, I hope everyone is enjoying the Christmas and holidays![/h1]

I just want to say how grateful I am for your support this year and I could not have done this without you!

I also want to give you a quick summary of what is currently being worked on and will be showing up during the Q1 of next year. You will in fact see some of these showing up within the next several weeks. 

I have been reading all your comments and feedback and I have found some of the items require special attention. Especially when it comes to interacting and vehicle operation. 

[h2]Improvements to Tiger and Vehicle Systems[/h2]
Tiger will be going through the next phase of its updates. You will see improvements to lighting, shadows, visuals, and mechanics such as fuel consumption and overheating. Tiger will also receive a hull machine-gun, interior and exterior lights, and smoke dischargers.

I am also reworking some of the driving systems to make the operation of vehicles a lot smoother and predictable, especially when shifting! And for those who prefer even simpler driving, you will have an automatic shift option in the settings. 

[h2]Input/Interactions[/h2]
While last update should have helped a lot, it is obvious that interactions still need improving and this is probably the most reported issue. I get it, if the controls are clunky it takes the fun out of the game.
Therefore, some of the things related to interaction will be further improved. If you have any opinions on the interactions, please let me know below. 

[h2]Movement [/h2]
Both walking and in-vehicle movement will be improved. And grab move will have dedicated grab points to prevent unintended grabs. Furthermore, if you are interacting with something, you will not be able to move at all. For walking movements, there will be an option to move towards where you are looking at or where the controller is being pointed at.

[h2]Crew Commands and Actions[/h2]
After reading what you have to say, I see that the current method of giving crew commands via the intercom is less than practical. It seems that a lot of you are having trouble with giving commands quickly, especially while on the move. I have decided to replace the intercom with an easy-to-use radial menu. This will be used for pretty much all the tank operations and other interactions, from giving commands to moving to a crew station. You will use the touch-pad or the thumb-stick to navigate in the menu.

[h2]Sandbox mode[/h2]
There will be a low threat sandbox mode where you can play with vehicles. You can get in and out of vehicles and take them for a spin and check out their driving and combat capabilities. There will be enemies but they will stay within a zone and will not come after you.

[h2]Game Engine[/h2]
Game engine will also be updated to the latest version. This will give us much better lighting, shadows and even some performance improvements.

[h2]Kettenkrad[/h2]
You will also see the next playable vehicle which is the Kettenkrad! 

[h2]Tutorial/Intro[/h2]
This is something that is lacking in the game and I understand not everyone knows how to drive a tiger tank or operate ww2 weaponry. I think this will help out our new comers  to get into the game.

[h2]Enter and Exit Vehicles[/h2]
One of most requested features is to be able to get out of vehicles. In one of the coming updates,  you will be able to get in and out of any playable vehicles. Please note that this is not so that you can play as infantry (at least not initially) but to perform tasks around the tank like looking ahead at the terrain/enemy or perform repairs etc.. 

Thanks again for your support and I hope you have a wonderful 2022! We got a lot coming!!

AFTC

notes.title: Armored Front is now on Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello Tank Commanders! 
 
[h1]Thank you for your long patience and supporting the game thus far! [/h1]

[h1]There are few things you should understand before purchasing/playing.[/h1]

[b]This game is not intended for VR beginners and you will need have some VR experience and understand the intricacies of VR. Game only features a smooth locomotion system and there is no teleport! 

This is an Early Access game. Game is currently at an Alpha state with a lot of work ahead. This means that the game is incomplete, buggy, imperfect, and can be frustrating to play! Content will be limited, especially in the beginning. Not only that, but as the game develops, things will be added, changed, or removed![/b]

[h3]If you would like a more complete game, I highly encourage you to wait for the final release! 

If you are OK with everything above, enjoy the game and thank you for being an early supporter! [/h3]

[h1]Levels[/h1]
There are 4 levels available now and I will be added few more in the next several days along with a map for the commander. 

[h1]Controls[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/43e23edf3fe710e882f14c948c627998feb26ba1.png[/img]

Controls are meant to be intuitive (if you do not feel that let me know!!), most controls can be grabbed (by pressing the grip button) or moved by simply pushing with your hand. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/9862ae89ab4677badcfd017e76fc7f01f6185616.png[/img]

[h1]Intecom[/h1]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/a32f12fe1822777ae7a46ed098710dbde3f3c031.png[/img]

You can use the intercom to give commands to your crew (note there is no radio operator at this time). 

[h1]Take it slow![/h1]
Don't rush into battle, first play around with the PAK 40 at the base and learn how the loading and firing works. Use the driving course to learn to drive the tank and give commands without the stress of combat. In combat keep your distance!

[h1]Bug reports and feedback[/h1]
When you find bugs, please report them via the bug report forum and please do create a new thread per issue so they can be easily tracked and dealt with. 

Also, you may provide feedback via steam forums or using our discord server: https://discord.gg/qTGT34U

[h3]
Lastly, here is a little tip that will come in handy! While grabbing a either the traverse or the elevation cranks, you can press trigger to fire the main gun or press the secondary button to fire the machine gun. [/h3]

[h1]Again, thank you for your support and going on this journey! Enjoy! [/h1]

notes.title: Development Progress Update #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Tankers![/h1]

It was yet another busy week but most of the work done was code-related, so there isn't anything too flashy to share today. However, I still wanted to give you a quick recap of what was done.

[h2]Tiger's Lower Hull[/h2]
This week, the lower hull was stripped of all its components and received a coat of "Afrika Korp Tropical" paint scheme. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/f1b08f3312fb36b279f48ba1e887463d96a42a23.png[/img]


But of course, the logistics company that was in charge managed to miss-handle it during transportation, I think they might be a little jealous! However, the camo we will be applying in the field will cover the scratches right up. And that reminds me, yes you will be able to change color schemes and camouflage in the future! Each camo scheme will adversely affect how you are detected by the enemy. ːsteamhappyː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/c1fc7502058d3d5515400f0c61094e6a2c616489.png[/img]


[h2]UI Interaction[/h2]
User Interface Interaction System was recreated from scratch this week. There will be a wrist menu (like a quick menu) which you can interact by touching, and a conventional menu (for settings, etc..) that uses a laser pointer for interacting. It is worth mentioning that, when it comes to menus, we want to use them as little as possible. Since this is a VR game an item should be accessible from your surrounding and not via a menu. 

That's all for today, see you next time!
AFTC

notes.title: Development Progress Update #1
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Tiger Commanders![/h1]

Just wanted to give you a quick status update on the development progress and share a few screenshots. Since the last announcement, it has been a very busy two weeks and a lot of progress was made in artwork and, in areas of code and framework. 

[h2]Art Update[/h2]
A new turret came out of the factory with an 88 gun and most of the vital parts. This should carry us up to the Early Access launch. However, do keep in mind that this model is by no means meant to be the final version. Please take this as a starting point and a work in progress. The model and the detail will be improved significantly over the course of the development. 

[h3]Commander Cupola[/h3]
Tiger commander had 7 periscopes in the cupola, giving a good 360-degree view of the battlefield. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/fed1d272df823a379ac6b03f66aadc597c9a6896.png[/img]

[h3]8.8 cm KwK 36 [/h3]
Generally referred to as "the 88", this feared gun was able to fire Panzergranate 39 (APCBC), HEAT, HE, and the Panzergranate 40 (APCR). In the game, you will also be issued smoke rounds. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/a7881a5284940429f0e14ebe698dfff102ac4081.png[/img]

[h2]Code/Framework and Game Systems Update[/h2]
There is a lot of existing code that will be reused from the previous version, but some systems will be completely overhauled or created from scratch including the interaction and locomotion system. During the last two weeks, a new locomotion system was introduced. Now, while in the tank, you can grab and drag yourself around, allowing you to move freely to any point within the tank with precision –you will see this in action in the coming weeks.

Hope you have a great weekend!
AFTC

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34331538/34939cda74e7d758bb5faaf0889db42fbb30fee0.png[/img]

notes.title: Armored Front: Tiger Command
notes.content:
Hello All,

I hope you are all safe during these uncertain times. I know it has been some time since my last update, but development has been going strong and I have some exciting news for you. I will try to keep this short, sweet, and to the point.

Armored Front will be taking a different turn and going big and heavy! Instead of the T34, you will now be taking command of the Legendary Tiger 1 Heavy Tank. The core concept will be more or less the same but from now on the game will be centered around a Tiger tank in North African Theatre.

[h2]What is new and will be available at Early Access release?[/h2]
[list]
[*] You will Take Command of a Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger
[*] The game takes place in the treacherous landscape of North Africa giving an open landscape better suited for tank combat 
[*] Driver Crew Station: Interactively drive the tank
[*] Gunner Crew Station: Manually (with touch controller) operate the mighty 88 gun
[*] Loader Crew Station: Play as the loader and manually load/unload the gun with different types of shells 
[*] Those who do not want to get their hands too dirty can also enable a simple loading system where the game will assist in the loading process
[*] Commander Crew Station: Give basic commands to AI tank crew, call-in support
[*] Call in Stuka close air support
[*] Call in artillery strikes
[*] AI tank crew and ability to give basic commands
[*] Field repair mode: perform basic repairs, rearm, give the crew a break, etc. 
[*] Create custom levels using the in-game Level Editor (it will be basic at first but evolve with the game)
[*] Skirmish gameplay mode 
[*] New renderer (much better visuals with improved performance)
[/list]

[h2]What is planned for Final Release?[/h2]
I have some exciting things planned but I want to avoid too much detail as certain things are still in progress. However, Career Mode featuring Grand Strategy, Open World Campaign, Advance AI,  and Tank Upgrades will remain as planned. Also, there will be improvements to everything listed above.

[h2]What about the Early Access release date? [/h2]
While I always have the best of intentions when I try to predict a release date, I hate potentially changing it and disappointing you all. Therefore, since there are many things that could affect game development, I am a little reluctant to predict when this would come out. For the time being, the release date is still to be decided.
 
There is still a lot of work ahead, but I am very excited and cannot wait to share more updates with you. While I am guilty of at times being too optimistic on timelines, I will do my best to share more on the new Tiger as soon as I can. I appreciate your continued interest and your patience so far. Stay safe out there!
